notes.note: Refs #3568 and #3575. Follow-up to the committed round-1 semantic review: removed the unused connection-catalog subscription, its type assertion and callback dependency from useActiveChatSessionMessaging after steering eligibility moved to the server declaration. This is behavior-neutral for admission, captured text/head, receipt reconciliation and caller notification; a connection-catalog refresh no longer needlessly recreates the send callback. All 121 focused messaging tests and the read-only scoped lint check pass. Existing document purpose, classification and source/script qualification limits remain; no native/provider/release execution is added.
